{{Quote|Giza. Tiatkin. Can you find them?''"<br />"''That's why we're taking your money.|Lando and Tiatkin|<ref name="Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref>}}
'''Tiatkin''', also known as '''Tia''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Eiattu pirates]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Radix]] alongside [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Giza]]. Tiatkin worked closely alongside Giza in their [[Tiatkin's starship|spaceship]]. She died in a battle against the pirates.
